full_judgment:
9. Had it been a normal lease under the development scheme then the blanks in that clause would have been filled in for the relevant years of the lease when catching fish would have been prohibited. Quite clearly, there has been interpolation in the lease deed and the petitioner, in collusion with the office assistant, has fraudulently inserted the figure "20" in the lease deed to make it a five year lease instead of a One year lease. 

 11. In view of our finding that there has been fraudulent interpolation in the lease deed, which has been created collusively by the petitioner and the concerned office assistant, and in view of the report of the inquiry conducted by the Deputy Commissioner, Sunamganj which shows that the concerned office assistant has been proceeded against, although it is not apparent what proceeding was drawn against him, prima facie it appears to us that offences mentioned in section 195(1)(C) of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been committed. Accordingly, we hereby direct the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sunamganj to take steps to obtain a copy of the concerned lease agreement dated 15.04.2009 between the Deputy Commissioner, Sunamganj on the 1st Part and Md. Mizanur Rahman, Secretary, Mukterpur ম.ম.স.লিঃ of the 2nd Part, and thereafter to take steps to initiate criminal proceeding against the petitioner Md. Mizanur Rahman and the concerned office assistant, and to intimate this Court through the Registrar. Supreme Court, as to what action has been taken, within one month of receipt of a copy of this judgment and order. Let a copy of the judgment, annexure A (12) and the inquiry report dated 18.04.2011, by keeping Photostat copies there after procuring from the record of the High Court Division, be communicated to the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sunamganj for taking action as per direction made above.
